author: JaDropping Science
description:
I'm excited to announce I'll be releasing a video game this Summer! I love social deduction games and wanted to make one where there's more substance to base your accusations on rather than just he said/she said. That's why I wanted to include Parkour where you can see if/how players mess up and use that as evidence towards figuring out the saboteur. In addition, based on how well you know your friends, you might be able to tell what types of trivia questions they would get right or wrong. If they miss a question you think they actually know, they might be the Class Clown and you should try to convince the group to suspend them. However, if you're wrong, then it's going to be even harder to pass the next quiz. Based on initial playtesting with friends, it's really fun! and I encourage you to check it out and wishlist the game on Steam if you're interested! Thanks for watching!

Here's a link to check out Stick Scholars on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4458310/Stick_Scholar
